text.insert: This page owns the workflow-local status and progress semantics of PR work: how campaigns, series, and feedback work items report where they stand as review work moves from preparation through execution and terminal outcomes.
The durable fields and nesting of
are defined once at the harness-state tier. This workflow page explains what their statuses mean without duplicating those canonical object shapes.
Campaign state names whether the durable review cycle is waiting, executing, or terminal:

| State | Meaning | Dispatch Authority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preparing` | The campaign exists at its stable source anchor while prepared series and their validation evidence are assembled; nothing is open upstream. | No campaign lease is implied. |
| `working` | An operator-entered activation is publishing, fixing, or validating series. | The campaign holds the dispatch lease. |
| `in_review` | At least one series is open upstream and no activation holds the lease. | Only background remote observation and feedback ingestion may advance series. |
| `completed` | Every series is merged or closed and the operator confirmed closure. | Terminal; the campaign cannot reacquire dispatch. |
| `abandoned` | The operator ended the campaign without requiring every series to complete. | Terminal; unpublished evidence remains readable. |
Series state separates local readiness, remote review, and terminal outcome so each source of evidence has one place to advance it:

| State | Meaning | Advanced By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `prepared` | The series is locally cut and gate-validated but is not open upstream. | A lease-holding activation |
| `published` | The series is open upstream and waiting for review. | An operator-confirmed publication batch |
| `changes_requested` | Review feedback exists as pending work. | Background observation or feedback ingestion |
| `revising` | Fixers own feedback work and may mutate the series workspace. | A lease-holding activation |
| `approved` | Remote review approved the series and merge is pending. | Background observation |
| `merged` | Upstream merged the series. Terminal. | Background observation |
| `closed` | The series was withdrawn or rejected without merging. Terminal. | Background observation or an explicit operator close |
Feedback work items resolve to one of two terminal outcomes. The table below defines whether the feedback was addressed or deliberately declined.

rows: The feedback was addressed by a pushed revision or answered in the review thread.
The feedback was deliberately not actioned and carries a reason.
